◆ create_available_spectrum_inquiry_message()

bool beerocks::SpectrumInquiryTask::create_available_spectrum_inquiry_message ( )

Creates and packs the Available Spectrum Inquiry message into the CmduMessageTx.

This method prepares the IEEE 1905.1 message for spectrum inquiry and populates the required TLVs before sending it to the controller.

Returns
true if the message was successfully created, false otherwise.
